result.summary: The page is largely coherent, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel has clear layout inconsistencies: the cards are vertically staggered with differing image heights and misaligned titles/subtitles, and one thumbnail uses a mismatched light background. A minor styling inconsistency also exists between the two favorite (heart) buttons.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the cards are not aligned on a shared baseline. The 'Smash Bros Burgers' card image starts ~20px lower than its neighbours and its title/delivery-fee text sit below those of 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccol…', producing a ragged, broken-looking row.
issues.suggestion: Give all carousel cards a fixed image height and align items to the top (e.g. flex align-items: flex-start with uniform card containers) so images, titles and delivery text share the same baselines.

issues.description: Card thumbnails in the same carousel are visually inconsistent: the 'Green Bowl Poké' image is shorter and rendered on a pale grey background while the other two use full-bleed dark photography, making the first card look unstyled/placeholder-like.
issues.suggestion: Standardise thumbnail aspect ratio and use object-fit: cover with a consistent background/treatment for all carousel images.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons are styled differently between the two 'Popular right now' cards: the Tokumaru Ramen card has a plain outlined heart with no backdrop, while the pizza card's heart sits on a dark circular chip.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same button treatment (same background chip, size and icon weight) to all favorite toggles for visual consistency and legibility over varied imagery.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' row omit rating information that is shown for 'Popular right now' items, so comparable restaurant cards present different metadata.
issues.suggestion: Include the rating (or explicitly justify the reduced compact layout) so restaurant cards convey consistent information across sections.
